title: Verify Foreman can delete a work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Foreman role. (this role has Work Order Lines: Delete).
The work order contains at least one line that is NOT in Complete status (a line can be deleted in any status except Complete).
steps:
1. Open the work order and locate a line that is not Complete.
2. Open the line's action menu, click Delete, and confirm.
expected: The line is deleted and removed from the work order.
